Markets.title: DIIs increase stake in 8 midcap stocks in Q2FY27
Markets.summary: Domestic institutional investors increased their holdings by over 2 percent in eight NSE midcap stocks during the quarter ending September 2026. The companies that saw these increased stakes include Swiggy, One97 Communications, Meesho, Cochin Shipyard, Lenskart Solutions, Piramal Finance, APL Apollo Tubes, and SBI Cards and Payment Services.

Markets.title: Bajaj Finance Q2 preview: Profit may jump 29%, NII 24% as strong loan growth lifts earnings
Markets.summary: Bajaj Finance expects a 29% jump in second-quarter net profit and a 24% rise in net interest income, driven by strong loan growth. However, analysts warn that rising borrowing costs could put pressure on the company's lending margins.

Markets.title: FPI selling crosses Rs 52,000 crore in October as Nifty defies foreign exodus
Markets.summary: Foreign portfolio investors withdrew more than Rs 52,000 crore from Indian equities in October due to rising US Treasury yields and high crude oil prices. Despite this foreign exodus, benchmark indices Nifty and Sensex rebounded sharply, driven by strong domestic institutional buying and gains in the IT sector.

Markets.title: Jefferies’ Chris Wood says it’s time to diversify beyond AI. Where should investors look now?
Markets.summary: Jefferies analyst Chris Wood advises investors to reduce heavy exposure to artificial intelligence stocks due to slowing earnings growth and high valuations. Instead, he recommends diversifying into Asian markets, including India and China, while maintaining targeted investments in semiconductor companies.

Markets.title: FPIs pull out Rs 52,100 cr from equities in Oct so far amid global headwinds
Markets.summary: Foreign portfolio investors withdrew Rs 52,100 crore from Indian equities in October following a net withdrawal of Rs 35,861 crore in September. This financial retreat was driven by elevated crude oil prices, higher US bond yields, and a stronger dollar.

Markets.title: Mcap of nine of top-10 most valued firms surges by Rs 3.65 lakh cr; TCS shines
Markets.summary: Last week, the market valuation of nine out of the top ten most valued Indian firms surged by a combined Rs 3.65 lakh crore, driven by a strong rally in the BSE Sensex and Nifty. Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), Bharti Airtel, and Infosys led the gains, while Larsen & Toubro was the only firm among the top ten to experience a decline.

Geo-Political.summary: Following nationwide protests in France, about 1,800 people were arrested after demonstrations escalated into riots and looting. The resulting violence left Paris streets littered with burnt-out cars and shattered glass.

Data & Insights.title: 800 million jobs at risk over 15 years? World Bank's Ajay Banga calls for global financing overhaul
Data & Insights.summary: World Bank President Ajay Banga warned that 1.2 billion young people will enter the global workforce over the next decade against only 400 million projected jobs. To address this and other challenges, the institution plans to increase critical minerals financing to $19 billion through 2030 while mobilizing more private capital.

Data & Insights.title: PM-SETU: Five ITI clusters to get  ₹1,195 crore investment from Tata Steel Foundation, BVG India, others
Data & Insights.summary: Tata Steel Foundation, BVG India, and three other companies will invest to upgrade five Industrial Training Institute (ITI) clusters under the PM-SETU scheme. This brings the cumulative approved investment under the scheme to ₹3,687 crore.

Data & Insights.title: Vibrant Goa summit to connect 220 Goan MSMEs with 300+ global buyers – What to expect?
Data & Insights.summary: The Government of Goa is hosting a three-day business summit from October 29 to 31 at the Dr Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Indoor Stadium. The event will connect 220 local MSMEs with over 300 global buyers and business leaders from more than 50 countries.

Data & Insights.title: ‘Most consequential change’: Kevin Warsh says AI will reshape US economy, warns of a ‘bumpy’ road ahead
Data & Insights.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh stated that artificial intelligence will boost productivity over time while potentially increasing inflation in the short term. He also warned that economic uncertainty and emerging markets could make the technological transition difficult.

India.title: 'Pandal Is Collapsing': On Camera, Kolkata Puja Crowd Scrambles, Then An Announcement

India.title: India Bars Sugar-Based Ethanol From 2026-27 Tender For Petrol Blend
India.summary: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd has issued a tender on behalf of oil marketing companies for 11 billion litres of ethanol to meet a 20 percent petrol-blending requirement. The tender, which begins its supply year in November, bars sugar-based ethanol for the 2026-27 period.

India.title: Food Regulator's Guidelines For Perishable Items Amid Festive Season
India.summary: India's food safety regulator has issued strict guidelines for businesses handling perishable food items during the festive season. The rules apply to all stages of the supply chain, including manufacturing, packing, storage, transportation, distribution, and sale.
